# Country scope. True for playable Mamluk / Egyptian hosts.
oe_pmam_is_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = MAM
		tag = EGY
		has_variable = oe_pmam_adopted_host
	}
}

# Country scope. Controls Mecca and Medina (Custodian of the Two Sanctuaries).
oe_pmam_holds_two_sanctuaries = {
	owns = location:mecca
	owns = location:medina

}

# Country scope. True once the Fifth Corps firearm cadre has been commissioned.
oe_pmam_fifth_corps_ready = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pmam_fifth_corps }
		var:oe_pmam_fifth_corps >= 1
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}
